messages:
Aisha (Design): sharing a quick screenshot — compact grid with action icons collapsed into a single surface. wondering if the current 32px tap target + subtle surface is enough for accessibility in the dense table view. https://figma.com/file/xyz :eyes:
Marcus (Frontend): looks tight. on mobile that 32px might be barely okay but desktop hover states are super subtle. i'd bump the hover/active surface contrast + add a visible focus ring for keyboard users.
Tom (DevEx): do we have a spacing token that maps to this density? we use --space-1 (4px) and --space-2 (8px) elsewhere. this layout is using a custom 6px gap which is a smell.
Aisha (Design): yeah the mock used 6px to keep columns compact. prefer keeping tokenized values. proposal: use --space-1 for inner padding and reduce row height by 4px — but keep action surface at minimum 44px touch area.
Jules (Product): minimum 44px touch area is important for mobile SLAs. but for dense desktop tables we should ensure visual clarity — higher contrast for action surfaces reduces misclicks.
Samira (Design Ops): quick accessibility check: contrast of the action surface background on hover is currently 1.6:1 vs the row bg — fails AA for non-text UI. design-bot can run a11y though.
design-bot: automated accessibility scan: test "compact-grid/action-surface-contrast" — contrast ratio 1.6:1 (required >=3:1 for UI components). keyboard focus detected: missing visible ring on action surface. suggestions: increase overlay opacity to 20% on hover and add 2px focus outline with accessible color token.
Marcus (Frontend): implementation note: we can do that with CSS variables. pseudo:
```
--action-overlay-opacity: 0.2;
.row .action-surface:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px }
```
But outlining within a cramped cell might cause layout shift; we can use box-shadow to avoid reflow.
Aisha (Design): box-shadow is fine. also thinking about icon padding — currently icons are centered but visually cramped. propose increasing left/right padding to 8px while keeping overall row height the same by shaving interior gaps.
Tom (DevEx): keep tokens consistent: use --space-2 (8px) for icon padding, update spacing scale doc; if we change row height, we need to update table density token (e.g., --row-height-compact).
Jules (Product): small copy point — the tooltip for the action menu says "More". can we make it more descriptive in compact mode, like "Row actions"? helps keyboard screen reader users.
Samira (Design Ops): agree — tooltips should be explicit. for screen readers make sure the menu button has aria-label="Row actions for {item name}".
Marcus (Frontend): noted. will add aria-label and aria-expanded handling. also will prefer aria-hidden on purely decorative icons.
Aisha (Design): ok, so action items: 1) Marcus to implement box-shadow focus + increase overlay opacity, 2) Tom to standardize tokens (--row-height-compact, --space-2 usage), 3) Samira to update a11y checklist, 4) me to update Figma and tooltips copy.
Jules (Product): timeline? I'd like a small canary on staging this week so PMs can sanity-check before next release.
Marcus (Frontend): i can do a PR today, add a story in Storybook for compact grid showing keyboard nav and contrast toggles.
Tom (DevEx): i'll update docs and add migration note for any token renames. also will run regression tests for spacing.
Aisha (Design): thanks all. i'll push updated frames to the figma link and tag @Samira when copy is ready. :thumbsup:
